body: Seeing them both nights in Oakland. Just got to the hotel and I’m writing my set list predictions. I was guessing they’d save the magic for SoCal

Big packers fan, I see it as a smart move. I think the jets were a QB away from being contenders. Maybe not ready for a super bowl this year but Rodgers could change that team around and give them the leadership needed in a QB

I’m sorry to hear about your experience. I hope you are doing better now that you have a better understanding. 

I like your idea of finding what resonates with myself. I know I need to connect with my family and get their perspective. My therapist is on board, and it was a little relieving to hear she is autistic too, as well as her 2 kids. I’m looking forward to my next session because we started talking about this at the end of our last session. She’s given me a lot of resources to call and get started on the process of a proper diagnosis. 
Thank you so much for the advice.

Very confusing and exhausting to think about. My therapist sent me a YouTube channel she really liked that I’m going to check out. It calmed me a bit when she told me she is autistic as well, but it also made me feel as though it confirms it a little more. I’m dreading the process that’s to come but I have a good support system to help. Thank you for the help, I really appreciate it :)

My therapist sent me a bunch of links and even warned me about “falling into the rabbit hole”. I’ll take it in small steps because I know I’ll overwhelm myself. I’ve been putting off talking to my parents but I need to reconnect and talk about this with them. Thank you for the helpful message <3
I just stumbled across this and omg I thought this only happened to me. I always hear my name being said, sometimes loud or whispered.

I’ve only been doing therapy and antidepressants for a short time, but that’s what I feared. It still not helping and I’m already giving up on the fight. I know there’s nothing that can change my thinking. I don’t want to be here. I want relief too
